text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hassan presides over cabinet meeting.
- Morocco and the Netherlands seek closer cooperation.
- Police pursue probe of explosion that killed six in residential area of Casablanca.
- European Commissioner on immigration visits Morocco.
- Morocco's representative to United Nations deplores U.N. lack of firmness which allowed the Polisario Front "to hijack" referendum proceedings in Western Sahara.
